subject: church moved on trailers
title: What If a Whole Town Had to Move? Kiruna Is, Church Included

scenes.text: What if your whole town had to move three kilometers? Kiruna, Sweden, is doing it, church included.
Under the Arctic town runs the world's biggest underground iron mine, now more than 1,365 meters deep.
As the mine chased the ore deeper, cracks opened in roads and buildings above.
In 2004 the decision came: build a new center three kilometers east and move about 6,000 people, over 20 to 30 years.
The new center opened in 2022. Historic houses travel whole on trailers; the rest are demolished.
In August 2025 the 672-ton church rolled five kilometers at half a kilometer an hour, two days on the road. Price of the whole move: about three billion euros.

description:
What if a whole town had to move? Kiruna, in Arctic Sweden, sits above the world's largest underground iron-ore mine, now more than 1,365 meters deep. As mining caused cracks in roads and buildings, the town decided in 2004 to build a new center three kilometers east and relocate about 6,000 people over 20 to 30 years. The new center opened in 2022.
In August 2025 the 672-ton wooden church was driven five kilometers on trailers at about half a kilometer an hour over two days. The total cost is around three billion euros.
